sentences.en: All families are, to a greater or lesser extent, dysfunctional.
sentences.zh: 所有家庭在某种程度上都是功能失调的。

sentences.en: Hinduism has a divine Trinity along with millions of lesser gods.
sentences.zh: 印度教有一个神圣的三神体系，此外还有数以百万计的次要神灵。

sentences.en: We chose the lesser of the two evils.
sentences.zh: 我们选择了两个恶中较轻的一个。
